newsitem.title: USA: Johnson & Johnson settles patent dispute.
newsitem.headline: Johnson & Johnson settles patent dispute.

text.p: Johnson & Johnson said it reached a settlement with Cook Group Inc over Cook's alleged infringement of the PALMAZ '665 patent for balloon- expandable devices that are used in opening blocked arteries.
Johnson & Johnson said the PALMAZ '665 patent was exclusively licensed to Johnson & Johnson in 1986.

The settlement with Cook involves royalty payments to Johnson & Johnson and a license to Cook under the PALMAZ '665 patent. It also provides for the termination of all litigation between Cook and Johnson & Johnson concerning the patent.
Terms of the settlement, including royalty payments, are confidential, it said.
